reason_values_are_null: There is no eligible frozen 1000/2000-design dataset or measured model/resource pilot. Gate 0 freezes how values must be derived; inventing percentages now would violate the acceptance TODO.

allowed_evidence: calibration partition for posterior calibration only
threshold-pilot optimization seeds declared by benchmark_preregistration.json
resource measurements captured before formal test access
forbidden_before_seal: offline test partition rawData, metrics, rankings, or plots
any result from a campaign later counted as formal acceptance evidence
required_provenance: metric implementation version and source SHA-256
numeric values, units, direction, aggregation, and missing-data policy
sealing_contract.post_test_change_rule: Any threshold change after test access creates a new experiment version and cannot make the original preregistration pass.

rawdata_representation.derivation_rule: Use paired validation-design bootstrap distributions across the five frozen model-fit seeds. Seal the smallest practically meaningful improvement/noninferiority limits supported by validation and baseline seed dispersion; values must be stated separately for 1000 and 2000 training designs and must not be inferred from test rows.
rawdata_representation.mandatory_pass_logic: At both train sizes, the new full-grid CAE must meet the sealed field-macro and current-cost rules; every field must stay within the sealed degradation cap. A macro win cannot hide an S11, gain, scalar, or curve collapse.

posterior.derivation_rule: Use only the calibration partition to fit spread scaling and validation/threshold-pilot decision evidence to choose support. Coverage tolerances must be justified against finite-sample binomial uncertainty; unique support is the smallest empirically distinct support that reaches a validation decision-quality plateau within the sealed resource budget. Repeated draws from the same member never increase support.
posterior.mandatory_pass_logic: Report rawData and cost calibration, multivariate score, correlation preservation, valid draws, projection failures, and support truthfully. Marginal coverage alone cannot pass the posterior gate.

optimization.reference_point: one per objective in minimization space
optimization.primary_endpoint: cumulative hypervolume after 2000 attempted real evaluations
secondary_endpoints: cumulative hypervolume at every 100-attempt generation boundary
attempted evaluations to sealed target hypervolume
optimization.derivation_rule: Use only the disjoint threshold-pilot seeds to freeze per-case noninferiority/improvement margins, the paired aggregation rule, and any target HV. Formal acceptance then uses the five untouched formal seeds, reports every paired value, the median paired difference, dispersion, and the sealed confidence rule. Failed candidates consume budget.
optimization.mandatory_pass_logic: The qNEHVI target arm must meet both sealed GPSAF and NSGA-III rules at equal attempted budget; no runtime, warning, or excluded pair may be silently treated as algorithm quality.

engineering_cost.derivation_rule: Measure data load, each CAE stage, posterior draw, rawData-to-cost projection, qNEHVI selection, restore, host RAM, and VRAM on the frozen resource block. Set caps from the measured validation/pilot envelope and the observed single-real-evaluation and generation budgets; never assume surrogate work is free because the real task is under one core-hour. A hardware change creates a separate resource block.

explicit_group_ablation.derivation_rule: Compare the frozen antenna S11/gain groups with groups=() on identical splits and seeds. Seal validation-derived benefit/noninferiority and overhead caps; groups=() must create no group parameters or checkpoint state.

coordinate_readout_gate.activation_rule: Remain disabled until the full-grid CAE passes its sealed 1000/2000-design representation and current-cost gates and a legal off-grid truth source, metric, tolerance, and resource budget are sealed without test access.

stop_if: any numeric threshold remains null before offline test access or formal optimization launch
the threshold author has seen the corresponding test/formal result
the sealed threshold file lacks dataset, metric-code, model, strategy, or environment identity
a threshold is changed after test access without declaring a new experiment version
